mentions.name: Puter
mentions.description: Open-source, self-hostable internet computer (web desktop environment) that people use for a wide range of things including cloud storage, web hosting, coding, AI, and gaming. Current development focus is improving performance so it runs as fast as a regular desktop environment.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I work on Puter (https://github.com/heyPuter/puter/); an open-source, self-hostable internet computer.

People use Puter for an incredibly wide range of things, including cloud storage, web hosting, coding, AI, and gaming. Right now, we're mostly focused on improving performance and making sure that it's as fast as a regular desktop environment!
